bullets.text: overcast, sixteen degrees, the sky doing the bare minimum and somehow that's exactly enough.
duck reached meiseki-ji under grey and stood with a borrowed line — invert, always invert. 🕊️
holding a problem upside down by the ankles to see what falls out of its pockets.
a dove settled where the rain had pooled, in no rush to mean anything.
the answer was behind the question the whole time, facing the other way.
